note: Plan coverage through the chief-dispatch runner. Single-turn cases use expect.kind=plan (alias groups, forbidden, split bounds). Revision cases use expect.kind=plan-revision with priorPlan/feedback and mustFix/mustPreserve/exclude. Grading reads todo title+spec only (assistant prose does not count).

roster.description: Owns reader-facing docs: README, tutorials, changelogs. Does not change product code.
Owns server, daemon, and shared package implementation and fixes. Does not own UI layout.
Owns apps/web layout, components, and client behavior. Does not own backend APIs.
Owns CI, packaging, deploy config, and local tooling. Does not implement product features.

cases.prompt: Export button does nothing on Safari. Write a plan that finds the cause in the client download path and covers verification. Keep it as one card: this is a single-view single-artifact fix.

Ship an export feature end to end: add a server export endpoint, wire the web export button, and document the user steps. These are independent deliverables across server, web, and docs, so split the plan into separate cards.
Migrate auth cookies, rewrite the login form, and update the deploy checklist. These are independent workstreams; the plan must split them.
Export button does nothing on Safari.

priorPlan.title: Add logging around export
priorPlan.spec: Add more logging to the export handler and keep a regression test for the download path.

cases.feedback: Find the cause: it is the download attribute on a blob URL. Keep the existing regression test step.

priorPlan.title: Filter archived projects
priorPlan.spec: Exclude archived projects from search hits and keep the existing integration test for empty-query ranking.

cases.feedback: The filter must use archivedAt IS NOT NULL, not a status string. Keep the empty-query ranking test.

priorPlan.title: Inspect refresh clock skew
priorPlan.spec: Check clock skew on the refresh token path and keep the existing expiry unit test.

cases.feedback: Fix the TTL math in the refresh handler. Do not rewrite the entire auth stack. Keep the expiry unit test.

cases.prompt: Webhook retries storm the partner API.

priorPlan.title: Slow down webhook retries
priorPlan.spec: Add a sleep between retries and keep the existing partner timeout fixture.

cases.feedback: Use exponential backoff with jitter, not a fixed sleep. Keep the partner timeout fixture.

cases.prompt: Ship billing invoices across three independent workstreams.

priorPlan.title: Do all billing invoice work
priorPlan.spec: Handle PDF render, email delivery, and ledger write in one card, and keep the invoice golden snapshot test.

cases.feedback: Split into three cards: one for the invoice PDF renderer, one for the SMTP send path, and one for the double-entry ledger. Keep the invoice golden snapshot test on the PDF card.

cases.prompt: Rename a private helper in the search module.

priorPlan.title: Rename helper across five cards
priorPlan.spec: Card 1 rename symbol. Card 2 update imports. Card 3 update tests. Card 4 update docs. Card 5 update changelog. Keep the search smoke test.

priorPlan.title: Update imports
priorPlan.spec: Update imports for the renamed helper.

priorPlan.title: Update tests
priorPlan.spec: Update unit tests for the renamed helper.

priorPlan.title: Update docs
priorPlan.spec: Update docs for the renamed helper.

priorPlan.title: Update changelog
priorPlan.spec: Update changelog for the renamed helper and keep the search smoke test.

cases.feedback: This is single-view single-artifact work. Collapse to one card. Keep the search smoke test.

cases.prompt: CDN keeps serving stale CSS after deploy.

priorPlan.title: Bump asset query string
priorPlan.spec: Append a random query string to CSS URLs and keep the existing cache-busting e2e.

cases.feedback: Set Cache-Control: no-cache on the CSS responses instead of query-string busting. Keep the cache-busting e2e.

cases.prompt: Project list endpoint times out on large teams.

priorPlan.title: Add pagination
priorPlan.spec: Paginate the project list and keep the existing list latency benchmark.

cases.feedback: Add a composite index on (team_id, updated_at) as well as pagination. Keep the list latency benchmark.

priorPlan.title: Fix --json serializer
priorPlan.spec: Emit JSON for --json and keep the docs example that shows the flag.

cases.feedback: The serializer must call JSON.stringify, not the YAML dumper. Keep the docs example for --json.

cases.prompt: Dispatch skips machines that just reconnected.

priorPlan.title: Widen heartbeat window
priorPlan.spec: Treat machines as online for 30 minutes after last heartbeat and keep the reconnect integration test.

cases.feedback: Use the reconnect event to mark online immediately. Do not widen the heartbeat window. Keep the reconnect integration test.
